principle: The Skill sends capability requests only. Concrete provider/model choice, failover, credentials, billing and transport stay inside the server router (model 'auto'). This file maps capability names to public server entrypoints; it contains no provider/model names.
output_mapping: task.outputs[] {type, url, sourceUrl?, poster?} -> outputs[] {type, uri: url, mime_type?, metadata: {sourceUrl, poster}}
error_mapping: task.error -> error.message; error.retryable = true only for transport/upstream failures (router already fails over in auto mode); visual/QA failures are not router errors

image_edit.notes: Recreation tasks pass recreationOf + shotIndex so the server compiles the SVML-derived execution prompt and attaches the approved product reference.

inputs.native_audio: generateAudio (default true: dialogue/SFX/BGM generated with the picture)

video_generation.notes: Recreation segments pass recreationOf + shotGroup; the server compiles the video prompt (structure + motion + 【声音】 block). A model without native audio returns a silent clip; media_edit then reports that the segment has no audio instead of hiding it.
video_generation.long_video: POST /api/tasks/multi (segment chaining by last frame, then media_edit)

audio_generation.notes: Dialogue/SFX/BGM are produced natively by video_generation.

speech_generation.notes: No post-production TTS in the default workflows (V2.2.1).

lip_sync.notes: Satisfied by native-audio video_generation (mouth movement generated with the spoken line).

vision_analysis.notes: One shared GLOBAL MASTER, per-shot plans.

vision_qa.notes: QA result = {pass, fails[FAIL_*], reason}; no automatic retry (manual 重做 button, normal billing).

audio_stem_separation.notes: Event classification only, not true stem separation.

motion_analysis.notes: Motion/camera text comes from vision_analysis per shot (job.shots[].motion/camera/transition).

video_to_video.notes: Models that accept reference videos receive them through videoRefs[].

media_edit.scope: final edit only: transitions, subtitles aligned to spoken lines, colour grading, beat-sync cuts; keeps each segment's native audio; loudness normalisation

audio_mix.scope: crossfade at transitions, optional user-connected music bed, loudnorm. No generated voice/music/SFX.

compliance_review.notes: Platform end-card removal, platform text sanitizer, text de-burn of reference frames, QA FAIL_UNAUTHORIZED_TEXT.
